data:
I made an instrumental song for the website of my uncle and his friend.
It has kind of a weird, melancholic aesthetic, so I made the song using vocal sounds and echo-y piano

It uses some drum and bass inspired drums halfway through the instrumental.

I used UltraBox, an online tool for making music.
SampleFocus for samples.
My voice for the vocal sounds

It's used by my uncle and his friend in their Strada Averta project.

I also used it in a game I made (play it here flashing lights!!!)
